dataset.title: Prevalence of Ehrlichia canis or Theileria equi co-infections in dogs that are naturally infected and clinically sick due to babesiosis (BET Study Dataset.xlsx)
dataset.licence: CC BY 4.0, taken from the known Figshare record metadata supplied with the task. Not re-read from the live record.
dataset.species: Domestic dog (Canis lupus familiaris), natural infection, Babesia rossi (149) and B. vogeli (1); E. canis co-infection in 3. Eastern Cape, South Africa per the article note.
dataset.design: Cross-sectional single-clinic cohort of clinically sick dogs with natural babesiosis, with one admission sample per dog in 2021. No babesiosis-negative controls, no treatment data, no follow-up or outcome. Used for co-infection prevalence and for haematology/biochemistry association analysis (including correspondence analysis, per the CORRESPONDENCE sheet).
notes: 'Entire population' sheet: header row 1, units row 2, 150 dog rows (BET001-BET150); the summary rows below the data (e.g. '82/150 MALE INTACT') were ignored.
Subject IDs with a note in the cell were cut to the ID: BET023 (B. rossi + E. canis); BET072 (B. rossi + E. canis); BET100 (B. vogeli); BET147 (B. rossi + E. canis).
'CORRESPONDENCE' sheet: 150 dog rows read for habitus and the authors' derived classes; the 'Crossbreed vs Purebreed' sheet repeats the same dogs and was not used.
Primary complaint codes with at least 8 dogs became yes/no flags: IA (137), L (77), HGUR (16), WL (12). Rarer codes stay in the primary_complaint text only.
Haematocrit agrees between the two sheets for all dogs except 0.
Numeric cells that hold text ('UNKNOWN', 'P+') are stored as missing for the numeric variable.
MCV, MCH, MCHC, WCC, ARC and globulin are arithmetic functions of other columns (derived_from); associations with their parents are flagged trivial by the experiment scripts.

variables.name: Sex and neuter status
variables.description: As recorded: MALE INTACT, FEMALE INTACT, FEMALE SPAYED, MALE CASTRATED. Tested through sex and neutered.

variables.name: Breed
variables.description: As recorded (21 values, 90 crossbreeds). Tested through breed_group.

variables.name: Primary complaint codes
variables.description: Owner complaint codes separated by '/', as recorded (IA, L, WL, HgUr, V, ...). Tested through the complaint_* flags.

variables.name: Duration of illness
variables.description: Owner-reported. 'UNKNOWN' stored as missing.

variables.name: Respiratory rate
variables.description: 'P+' (panting, 24 dogs) stored as missing here and as panting = yes.

variables.name: Mucous membranes
variables.description: Free text as recorded. Tested through mm_pale and mm_icteric.

variables.name: Peripheral lymph node enlargement
variables.description: 0 none palpable, 1 one to three nodes palpable, 2 more than three nodes palpable.

variables.name: Ticks present
variables.description: present / absent at examination.

variables.name: Mean cell volume
variables.description: Calculated index: haematocrit / RCC.

variables.name: Mean cell haemoglobin
variables.description: Calculated index: haemoglobin / RCC.

variables.name: Mean cell haemoglobin concentration
variables.description: Calculated index: haemoglobin / haematocrit.

variables.name: White cell count
variables.description: Sum of the differential counts.

variables.name: Eosinophils
variables.description: Zero in 84 of 150 dogs.

variables.name: Basophils
variables.description: Zero in 146 of 150 dogs; excluded from the default test set.

variables.name: Other cells
variables.description: Zero in 148 of 150 dogs; excluded from the default test set.

variables.name: Absolute reticulocyte count
variables.description: Calculated: reticulocyte % x RCC.

variables.name: Globulin
variables.description: Calculated: total protein - albumin.

variables.name: Babesia rossi PCR
variables.description: positive in 149 of 150; no variance to test.

variables.name: Babesia vogeli PCR
variables.description: positive in 1 of 150.

variables.name: Ehrlichia canis PCR
variables.description: positive in 3 of 150; too few to test.

variables.name: Theileria equi PCR
variables.description: positive in 0 of 150.

variables.name: Date collected
variables.description: DD/MM/YYYY in the file, 2021.

variables.name: Season
variables.description: Southern-hemisphere season of the admission date, as coded by the authors.

variables.name: Sex
variables.description: Male / Female, from sex_status.

variables.name: Neutered
variables.description: yes / no, from sex_status. Only 7 of 150 dogs are neutered, so it is excluded from the default test set.

variables.name: Breed group
variables.description: Crossbreed, Pitbull, Boerboel or Other purebred (every other breed, 21 dogs across 18 breeds).

variables.name: Purebred
variables.description: yes / no. Redundant with breed_group; excluded from the default test set.

variables.name: Panting at examination
variables.description: yes where respiratory rate was recorded as 'P+'.

variables.name: Pale mucous membranes
variables.description: yes where the mucous membrane text contains 'PALE' (including 'PALE PINK'); 'PMG' and 'HYPERAEMIC' are no.

variables.name: Icteric mucous membranes
variables.description: yes where the mucous membrane text contains 'ICTER' (icteric or slight icterus).

variables.name: Month of admission
variables.description: From date_collected. Season is the tested form.

variables.name: Primary complaint includes IA
variables.description: yes where the primary complaint codes include 'IA' (137 dogs). Code as recorded by the authors.

variables.name: Primary complaint includes L
variables.description: yes where the primary complaint codes include 'L' (77 dogs). Code as recorded by the authors.

variables.name: Primary complaint includes HGUR
variables.description: yes where the primary complaint codes include 'HGUR' (16 dogs). Code as recorded by the authors.

variables.name: Primary complaint includes WL
variables.description: yes where the primary complaint codes include 'WL' (12 dogs). Code as recorded by the authors.

variables.name: Habitus (mental status) score
variables.description: Admission mental status as graded by the authors: 4+ bright, alert and responsive; 3+ mildly depressed; 2+ and 1+ severely depressed or collapsed. Stored as the number (1-4); higher is brighter.

variables.name: Breed group (authors' FCI-style grouping)
variables.description: Br_G gundog, Br_H hound, Br_P pastoral, Br_U utility, Br_To toy, Br_Te terrier, Br_W working, Br_NL not listed, Br_M mixed.

variables.name: Age class
variables.description: Ag_1 under 12 months, Ag_2 12-24 months, Ag_3 over 24 months. Derived from age_months.

variables.name: Duration of illness class
variables.description: DI_1 1-3 days, DI_2 4-6 days, DI_3 over 7 days. Derived from illness_days.

variables.name: Habitus class
variables.description: BAR bright alert responsive (4+), Mi_De mildly depressed (3+), De_Co depressed or collapsed (2+ or less). Derived from habitus_score.

variables.name: Anaemia grade
variables.description: Ht_N non-anaemic, Ht_Mi mild, Ht_Mo moderate, Ht_S severe, Ht_VS very severe. Derived from haematocrit.

variables.name: White cell count class
variables.description: WCC_Lo leukopenia (<6), WCC_N normal (6-15), WCC_Hi leukocytosis (>15 x10^9/L). Derived from wcc.

variables.name: Band neutrophil class
variables.description: BaN_N normal (0-0.5), BaN_H high (>0.5 x10^9/L). Derived from band_neutrophils.

variables.name: Left shift
variables.description: none, L_shft left shift (bands > 0.5), De_L_shift degenerative left shift (bands > segmented). Derived from the neutrophil counts.

variables.name: Monocyte class
variables.description: Mon_N normal or low (<1.35), Mon_Hi monocytosis (>1.35 x10^9/L). Derived from monocytes.

variables.name: Reticulocyte response class
variables.description: ARC_In inadequate (<80), ARC_Mi mild (80-150), ARC_Mo moderate (150-300), ARC_Ma marked (>300 x10^9/L). Derived from arc.

variables.name: Reticulocyte response class (second scheme)
variables.description: ARC_Lo low (<12.86), ARC_N normal (12.86-115.41), ARC_Hi reticulocytosis (>115.41 x10^9/L). Derived from arc.

variables.name: Globulin class
variables.description: Glo_Lo low (<20), Glo_N normal (20-41), Glo_Hi high (>41 g/L). Derived from globulin.
